prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1193; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle was struck while turning left, and the damage seen on the front quarter panel, bumper cover, and left headlamp assembly lines up well with that impact direction. Parts and labor are itemized on the estimate, and the repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, refinishing the fender, and aligning the headlamp mounts. The labor hours run a little high for this level of damage, so a second look at the blend and refinish times may be worthwhile. No prior damage to the vehicle is known, and the repair invoices show no repeated charges for the same work.
